text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...That was a truly majestic run.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Now I am truly looking forward
to the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" next month!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I make sure <chrname> hears the encouraging words from Chairwoman Akikawa and Mei Satake, who rushed over right after the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It was her first race after returning from abroad. Although she was defeated, she gained valuable experience."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Satake-san!

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was so close~.
If only they were at their best!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Mm.
Ah, yeah—

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you can win it, right?
I know you and the others can, <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text: This is the first time I've ever seen Japan this excited for the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe"!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
Not on a racing program, but on a daytime talk show,
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was being reported on day after day.

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
"Public viewing tickets at movie theaters
are completely sold out at this point!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
It's said that on that day, tens of thousands of race fans
head to racecourses across the nation to cheer them on—

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is eagerly awaiting
Japan's first historic achievement.

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
So even if I were to lose in the Prix Niel...
...there's still a ray of hope, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure if it's you guys, <chrname>,
you can win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right...?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...! Trainer <username>.
I have something to discuss—
choice_data_list: ...As things stand now, our chances of winning are slim, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's correct.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The way today's Prix Niel unfolded
was extraordinarily grueling.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Closing this current gap
will require an immense amount of effort."
choice_data_list: Will I make it in time if I just work hard enough?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
! <chrname>,
you too—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I will make it.
...I'll make sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: You guys—can become stars!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, all the representative members
were gathered together in the gym.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To cover the weaknesses exposed in today's race,
and to gain the strength needed to overcome them."

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Mei.
Are you watching that interview again?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Because it sounds so cool!
'Building a bridge across the world'!"

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"Then why not just tell her yourself?
You're already Speed Symboli's
"companion," after all."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "...That's... Well, who cares, anyway?"

text_block_list.name: Grandfather Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Mei, could you translate this for me?
An airmail letter arrived from France.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Mei. You should come along on the next overseas training trip too.
I'll introduce you to the trainers over there.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Heheh, yours truly is as popular as ever!

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: ...Right, Mei.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"You will surely witness it.
The day we stand as equals with the world.
The day Japan becomes the greatest in the world."

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to that day.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure everyone is waiting
for a victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, too.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mei.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yayoi. The bridge to the world will be built soon.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The era where it's dismissed as a fairy tale is over,
and everyone who dreams will be given a chance!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Our dream will surely come true.
